info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Investment Portfolio Dividends-v1-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Dividends API provides access to the dividend information related to investment portfolios. Users can retrieve detailed records of dividends earned from their investments, which aids in financial reporting and portfolio management. This API is particularly useful for financial analysts and portfolio managers seeking to stay informed about dividend income and performance. By integrating this API, consumers can streamline their tracking of dividend distributions, enhancing their investment decision-making processes.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of dividends for a specific portfolio.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed information about dividends associated with a specified portfolio. It provides essential data about each dividend, including amounts and payment dates, to help users track their investment returns effectively.
